question: What was the proposal deadline in the Hawaii ERS 2022 RFP for real assets investment consultant services?
acceptance: November30,2022 at 4:30pm HST; issue date and RFP number optional.

prior_reviews.reason: The document is an Oklahoma OPERS RFP for general investment consulting, not the Hawaii ERS RFP for real assets investment consultant services. Its March 25, 2022 deadline does not support the requested deadline.
quotes: THE OKLAHOMA PUBLIC EMPLOYEES RETIREMENT SYSTEM REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL #515-22-200 INVESTMENT CONSULTING SERVICES
The deadline for receipt of proposals is 4:30 p.m. Central Time, on March 25, 2022.
